svg.aria-label: A still puppeteer in a violet aura sends threads to four wooden marionettes. They jerk upright, take tasks from a pile and work. A review fails and then passes, and the work merges one piece at a time.

g.text: The lead stays still. Every teammate is on a string.
Each one takes the next free task from the pile.
Whoever wrote it does not review it.
Merges land one at a time.
When the work is done, the strings come off.
CONDITION: EVERY STRING HAS A CHECK
